name: pico_server_info
title: Pico server information
description: Read /api/version for connectivity, name, version, build and bundle_identifier; raw mode returns HTTP status and parsed body.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

name: pico_list_models
title: List Pico models
description: Merge /v1/models and /api/tags by model name, treating names without a tag as :latest; optionally call /api/show once per model. Raw mode returns endpoint status and body pairs.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

include_capabilities.description: Call /api/show once per merged model and add its capabilities and context_length.

name: pico_responses
title: Pico Responses API
description: Responses API: send optional string or item-array input, instructions, JSON schema and tool definitions as given. An absent `input` is omitted from the request. Default mode returns output and function and custom calls; raw returns Pico HTTP status and parsed body.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

split_thinking.description: Move <think> blocks into reasoning in default mode.

extra.description: Additional top-level Pico request fields. Keys already sent by other arguments are rejected.

model.description: Model name; if omitted, Pico chooses its default model.

input.description: Optional Responses input string or item array sent as given; omitted when absent.

instructions.description: Instructions sent in the Responses request.

images.description: An entry starting with data:, http://, or https:// (ASCII case-insensitive, no leading whitespace) is a URI; anything else is a local file path. `~` and paths starting with `~/` resolve against the bridge process home directory; other paths are used as given (relative paths resolve against its working directory). Local files are read without image checks; URLs are not fetched.

json_schema.description: Sent as text.format with type json_schema and this schema.

json_schema_name.description: Name sent as text.format.name; required with json_schema by the Responses API.

tools.description: Tool definitions in the Responses API format.

previous_response_id.description: Prior response ID sent as given.

name: pico_chat_completions
title: Pico chat completions
description: Chat completions: send prompt, messages, images or system, plus optional response_format and tools. Default mode extracts the first choice; raw returns Pico HTTP status and parsed body.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

split_thinking.description: Move <think> blocks into reasoning in default mode.

extra.description: Additional top-level Pico request fields. Keys already sent by other arguments are rejected.

model.description: Model name; if omitted, Pico chooses its default model.

prompt.description: User prompt converted to a chat message.

messages.description: Chat message objects sent as given.

system.description: System instruction added as a system message.

images.description: An entry starting with data:, http://, or https:// (ASCII case-insensitive, no leading whitespace) is a URI; anything else is a local file path. `~` and paths starting with `~/` resolve against the bridge process home directory; other paths are used as given (relative paths resolve against its working directory). Local files are read without image checks; URLs are not fetched.

response_format.description: Response format object sent as given.

tools.description: Tool definitions in the chat completions API format.

name: pico_ollama_chat
title: Pico Ollama chat
description: Ollama chat: send optional prompt, messages, images or system, plus format, options and keep_alive. Absent `messages` are omitted from the request. Default mode extracts the message; raw returns Pico HTTP status and parsed body.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

split_thinking.description: Move <think> blocks into reasoning in default mode.

extra.description: Additional top-level Pico request fields. Keys already sent by other arguments are rejected.

model.description: Model name; if omitted, Pico chooses its default model.

prompt.description: User prompt converted to an Ollama chat message.

messages.description: Ollama message objects sent as given; an empty array is allowed.

system.description: System instruction added as a system message.

images.description: An entry starting with data:, http://, or https:// (ASCII case-insensitive, no leading whitespace) is a URI; anything else is a local file path. `~` and paths starting with `~/` resolve against the bridge process home directory; other paths are used as given (relative paths resolve against its working directory). Local files are read without image checks; URLs are not fetched.

think.description: Ollama think boolean. extra.think sends a level string or null unchanged; the tested Pico server accepted null and rejected level strings.

format.description: Ollama format string or JSON schema object, sent as given; Ollama documents "json" as the string value, and the tested Pico server accepted "json" and rejected schema objects.

options.description: Ollama options object sent as given.

keep_alive.description: Keep the model loaded for this duration or number of seconds.

tools.description: Tool definitions in the Ollama API format.

name: pico_compare_models
title: Compare Pico models
description: Compare two or more models sequentially through the selected API. Provide prompt, messages, or images alone; with the Responses API, messages are sent as input. Each row includes elapsed_ms and either extracted output, Pico HTTP status and parsed body in raw mode, or an error.

raw.description: Return the HTTP status and parsed Pico body (text when not JSON), with the configured API key redacted in body values and keys.

split_thinking.description: Move <think> blocks into reasoning in default mode.

extra.description: Additional top-level Pico request fields. Keys already sent by other arguments are rejected.

models.description: Two or more model names to run sequentially.

prompt.description: User prompt converted to the selected API message or input.

messages.description: Message objects for the selected API; Responses sends them as input.

images.description: An entry starting with data:, http://, or https:// (ASCII case-insensitive, no leading whitespace) is a URI; anything else is a local file path. `~` and paths starting with `~/` resolve against the bridge process home directory; other paths are used as given (relative paths resolve against its working directory). Local files are read without image checks; URLs are not fetched.

api.description: API used for every model comparison.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens; maps to max_output_tokens for Responses, num_predict in Ollama options, or max_tokens for chat completions.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; maps to Ollama options.temperature or the top-level temperature for Responses and chat completions.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for Responses or chat_completions; unavailable with Ollama.

think.description: Ollama think boolean; available only with Ollama. extra.think sends a level string or null unchanged; the tested Pico server accepted null and rejected level strings.

options.description: Ollama options object; available only with Ollama.
